title: Actions of $(\mathbb{Z}/4)^4$ on rationally connected threefolds
summary: Let $G=(\mathbb{Z}/4)^4$. We prove that if $X$ is a rationally connected threefold with a faithful action of $G$, then $X$ is $G$-birational to the Fermat quartic threefold. If $X$ is a terminal $G\mathbb{Q}$-Fano threefold, this birational equivalence is biregular. Consequently, the group $G$ acts faithfully on a rationally connected threefold but does not embed into $\operatorname{Cr}_3(\mathbb{C})$.
